title: Wiki Freshness Queue Entry
description: One line of .metaproject/data/wiki/freshness-queue.jsonl. Written by a git hook, which must not read the file, build the graph, or call a model. Consumed by `keryx wiki freshness`.

event.description: Which hook produced the entry. `manual` is a human-run `keryx wiki freshness --record`.

rev.description: Full 40-character git sha of the commit this entry describes. For post-merge, the resulting merge commit.

previousRev.description: Full git sha the change is measured from. Absent for the first recorded entry.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths touched by this revision, as reported by git. Not classified: classification happens at drain time, because the hook has no budget for it.

truncated.description: True when `paths` was capped by the hook's size limit. A truncated entry forces the drain to fall back to `git diff` for this revision rather than trusting the list.
